goal: Let node operators and IPC mining clients inspect memory pinned by active block templates
Help prevent unmonitored memory usage when evicted mempool transactions remain in templates
agreement: Strong support with all earlier objections resolved
Concept approval because it provides tracking needed to limit template memory (ryanofsky)
Verified by running with a Stratum v2 template provider on mainnet for 20 hours (xyzconstant)
Code review approval verifying template reference locking and lifetime handling (enirox001)
